screens.name: DASH CUSTOM mode, edit session
screens.notes: A 4th HUD placement mode (GDX_HUD_PLACEMENT_CUSTOM, beyond ALL_TOP/SPLIT/ALL_BOTTOM), reached by cycling the MODE chip (label reads 'MODE Z') or the DBG tab's 'HUD EDIT' button (reachable even with no live race -- sample values shown). CUSTOM mode never reuses the baked pixel art the other 3 modes do (a baked asset can't stretch to an arbitrary user size): every editable widget is a generic flat box (sCustomWidgets[], gdx3ds_bottomhud.c) with a short label and a live value, draggable (8px grid snap) and resizable (8 or 16px steps per widget; dash-portrait/RANK is drag-only, fixed size). This screen depicts an EDIT SESSION specifically (the EDIT button reads 'DONE', widgets show close/resize handles and the LAP widget is SELECTED mid-drag); the plain CUSTOM view (not editing) looks the same minus the handles/tray and with the EDIT button reading 'EDIT'. RESET restores every widget to its ALL_BOTTOM default position, all visible, and saves immediately; DONE exits edit mode and saves the current layout -- hud.ini's own [custom] section, written only on RESET/DONE, never every frame. GAP and standings (TOP5) have no top-screen counterpart at all (hide-only); every other editable widget maps to one GDX_HUD_ELEM_* bit (gdx3ds_hudcustom.h) that the eventual real native/nihudtop top-screen gating will read via gdx_hud_set_custom_top_mask() -- until that merges, the top screen simply follows ALL_BOTTOM behaviour while CUSTOM is active (gdx3ds_bottomhud_placement_mode() reports ALL_BOTTOM to port/input_bridge.c for any CUSTOM mode).
